Title: [Feature]: Load Real Geospatial Data (26,000+ Parcels)
Body:
## Problem
Currently RICH only displays 4 hardcoded sample parcels with empty geometries. The platform lacks real geospatial data for meaningful visualization and analysis.

## Verified Data Sources (All Approved)
- **CERSGIS Ghana Cocoa** - 21,031 parcels (https://zenodo.org/records/16579443)
- **SITEX Dehesa** - ~5,000+ parcels (https://sitex.gobex.es/)
- **Ethiopia Coffee** - 1,000+ parcels (https://ethiopia.opendataforafrica.org/)

All meet criteria: 100+ parcels, reputable, verified, open license, recent (2020-2025).

## Solution
Use scripts/generate_sample_parcels.py to generate 300 sample parcels across all regions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] 100+ real parcels loaded in database
- [ ] Parcels display on map with proper geometries
- [ ] All 3 regions (GH-AH, ET-OR, ES-EX) have sample data
- [ ] Source attribution preserved in metadata

## Priority
P1 - Data foundation

## Area
geospatial, data

Title: [Feature]: Implement Professional Color Scheme
Body:
## Problem
All parcels currently use hardcoded #10b981 (emerald green) color. No visual differentiation between agroforestry subtypes (shade_cocoa, dehesa, etc.).

## Solution
Implement Viridis-based scientific color palette:
- agroforestry: #2ca25f
- forest: #267838
- cropland: #fdae61
- grassland: #d1e5fe
- settlement: #e7298a
- water: #636eva

Subtype-specific colors for better visual distinction.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Color palette defined in types/index.ts
- [ ] MapViewer uses subtype-specific colors
- [ ] Colors follow scientific visualization best practices
- [ ] Color legend added to UI

## Priority
P1 - Visualization improvement

## Area
design, frontend, geospatial

Title: [Task]: Enhance CI/CD Based on hodaripay Patterns
Body:
## Context
Review hodaripay repository CI/CD patterns and apply best practices to RICH.

## hodaripay Patterns to Adopt
1. **PR Checks**:
   - Conventional commit title validation
   - Secret scanning with gitleaks
   - Shared package checks (ruff, black, mypy, ESLint)
   - Migration linting
   - ADR validation
   - Dependency audit (non-blocking)

2. **Main Branch Guard**:
   - Prevent direct pushes to main
   - Verify commits arrive via PR
   - File issue on violation

3. **Deploy Staging**:
   - Run tests before deploy
   - Detect backend changes to skip unnecessary deploys
   - Migrate Neon database
   - Seed content
   - Deploy to Railway
   - Smoke tests
   - Tag last deployed commit

4. **Promote to Production**:
   - Manual workflow_dispatch
   - Requires GitHub environment with reviewer
   - Migrate production database
   - Deploy to Railway
   - Smoke tests
   - Tag production commit

## Current RICH State
- [x] PR Checks workflow exists
- [x] Deploy to Staging workflow exists
- [x] Promote workflow exists
- [ ] Main branch guard missing
- [ ] Migration linting in PR checks
- [ ] Secret scanning in PR checks
- [ ] ADR validation missing
- [ ] Conventional commit validation missing
- [ ] Change detection for backend deploys missing

## Tasks
- [ ] Add conventional commit validation to pr.yml
- [ ] Add secret scanning (gitleaks) to pr.yml
- [ ] Add migration linting script and job
- [ ] Add ADR validation to pr.yml
- [ ] Create main-guard.yml workflow
- [ ] Add change detection to deploy-staging.yml
- [ ] Add database migration step to deploy-staging.yml
- [ ] Add smoke tests to deploy-staging.yml
